DATASET: Electric & Combustion Vehicle Specifications Database
TOTAL RECORDS: 6000
DESCRIPTION: Each record below describes a single vehicle model with full technical, pricing, safety, and running-cost specifications. Records are self-contained (each includes model, brand, and all key attributes) so they can be retrieved independently.

FIELD GLOSSARY:
- Segment: EU market class, A (smallest/city car) to F (largest/luxury)
- Usable Battery (kWh): 0 for non-electric (ICE) vehicles
- Efficiency (Wh/km): energy consumption per km; for ICE vehicles this is a normalized equivalent figure
- ADAS Level: Advanced Driver Assistance System level, 0 (none) to 3 (high automation)
- Safety Rating: Euro NCAP star rating, 1 to 5
- Insurance Rating: insurance group/risk rating, 1 (cheapest) to 5 (most expensive)
- Usage Type: primary intended use, Personal or Fleet
